name="fgsl"
version="0.0.0"
license="GPL-2.0-or-later"
[library]
source-dir="playground-library"
include-dir=[".","playground-generated"]
[build]
auto-executables=false
auto-examples=false
auto-tests=false
link=["gsl","gslcblas","m"]
[install]
library=true

scope: FGSL wraps GSL numerical routines. Broad classifications follow the exported interfaces for special functions, linear algebra, interpolation, root finding, optimization, integration/differentiation, ODEs, transforms, fitting and statistics. The checked consumer adapts the author's QAGS example and independently verifies the integral of log(x)/sqrt(x) on [0,1] against -4, status and error estimate. The procedure mapping covers adaptive one-dimensional finite-interval quadrature; other numerical interfaces are not runtime-verified by this example. Upstream Autoconf probes generated the complete configuration on GNU/Linux LP64 with GSL 2.8. An audited asset stages that header as config.inc; checksum-guarded edits change only its include filename in Fortran and C. The C support object and pinned system GSL libraries are linked. Local exports include the asset and patches; this configuration targets GNU/Linux LP64, and another ABI or GSL version requires regeneration against its local tools. GPL-2.0-or-later notices are retained.
generated_source_support: See ../../fpm-generated-sources.md; exact assets and input hashes are included in local project exports. Generation runs only during operator maintenance.
resolved_preparation_blocker: Upstream Autoconf probes generated the complete GNU/Linux LP64 / GSL 2.8 configuration; fgsl_utils.c is compiled and linked with GSL. Only the configuration include filename is patched. The initial consumer also needed an explicit intrinsic c_loc import; no numerical library routine was modified.
